title_original: Beyond Unified Detection: What Email Security Teams Need to Control
description: For email security teams, evaluating an integration means understanding both the detections it brings together and the quarantine management and administrative workflows it supports. Proofpoint’s integration with Microsoft’s Integrated Cloud Email Security (ICES) ecosystem brings its post-delivery detections into Microsoft Defender and consolidates investigation and remediation workflows. For customers, the next step is to understand how that integration supports their requirements for administrator-configured enforcement. Within ICES, Microsoft applies enforcement based on submitted verdicts, verdict severity, and configured policies. Proofpoint contributes its assessments within that model; a third-party engine does not independently override a Microsoft malicious verdict through ICES.
